# Placenta xQTL Atlas {.unnumbered}

**A cross-ancestry atlas of molecular quantitative trait loci in the human
placenta — from association mapping to fine-mapped causal variants.**

This site accompanies the
[`Placenta_xQTL_atlas`](https://github.com/sbresnahan/Placenta_xQTL_atlas)
repository. The two analysis reports and their two companion literature
reviews are rendered as native chapters of this site — use the sidebar to
navigate between sections, or start from any document below.

## How to read this atlas {.unnumbered}

Start with **Report 1** for the association-mapping landscape, then **Report
2** for the fine-mapped causal-variant resolution. The two **literature
reviews** are narrative companions that interpret the headline loci against
prior work; each cites an indexed evidence table
(`xqtl_top_hits_evidence_table.csv`, `finemap_hits_evidence_table.csv` in the
repository `reports/` folder).

## Source and data {.unnumbered}

The bookdown source for this site lives in the repository `bookdown/` folder;
analysis sources, helper modules, and companion tables live in `reports/`.
Self-contained standalone HTML versions of the four documents are distributed
separately with the reports archive. Input data are regenerated on the
computing cluster with `reports/make_report_archive.sh`.
